dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a narrow pixel radius, transitioning between an acute and narrowly obtuse tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, measured at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.7:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.
